pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 9.4.1 PLAY: STYLE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.4: Reading 9.4.1 Play: Style

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 9.4.1 Play: Style. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do authors use flashback,flashforward and personification in plays?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify features of style used in a play

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify features of style used in a play
   In simple words: practise until you can identify features of style used in a play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 9.4.1 Play: Style using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 9.4.1 Play: Style in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 9.4.1 Play: Style to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 9.4.1 Play: Style.
4. Show that you can: identify features of style used in a play

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 9.4.1 Play: Style using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 9.4.1 Play: Style important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read aloud excerpts of a play,
2. Discuss the role of memories, dreams and a story within the storyas flashback in a play,
3. Collaboratively, role play some events in which the flashback, flash forward and personification feature in the play,
4. Dramatise some of the events in a play and make video recordings,
5. Digital literacy: It is promoted as the learner makes video recordings of peers dramatising some of the events in a play.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify features of style used in a play

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
